people.name: Rhonda Patrick
people.title: PhD, biomedical science / science communicator
people.known_for: Deep-dive reviews of vitamin D, omega-3, sulforaphane, micronutrient RDA gaps; member of the Linus Pauling Institute external advisory board history

people.name: Chris Masterjohn
people.title: PhD, Nutritional Sciences
people.affiliation: Independent (formerly Brooklyn College / University of Illinois)
people.known_for: Educator on fat-soluble vitamins A/D/K2 interplay, methylation, nutritional biochemistry; 'Masterjohn on Health' platform

people.name: Michael F. Holick
people.title: MD, PhD, Professor of Medicine, Physiology & Biophysics
people.known_for: Seminal vitamin D deficiency reviews (NEJM 2007); discovery of 25(OH)D and 1,25(OH)2D physiology; proposed global deficiency figures

people.name: William S. Harris
people.title: PhD, lipid biochemist
people.affiliation: Sanford School of Medicine (University of South Dakota); OmegaQuant
people.known_for: Co-developer of the Omega-3 Index (RBC EPA+DHA %) as a cardiovascular risk biomarker (2004)

people.name: Kate Rheaume-Bleue
people.title: ND (Naturopathic Doctor)
people.known_for: 'Vitamin K2 and the Calcium Paradox' (2011) — popularized MK-7 and Matrix Gla Protein narrative

people.name: Leon J. Schurgers
people.title: PhD, Professor of Biochemistry of Vascular Calcification
people.known_for: Landmark MK-7 vs MK-4 pharmacokinetic and Matrix Gla Protein research (Blood 2007)

people.name: Bruce N. Ames
people.title: PhD, Professor Emeritus of Biochemistry
people.known_for: 'Triage theory' of micronutrient deficiency; LPI contributor on long-term deficiency consequences

people.name: Jørn Dyerberg
people.title: MD, DMSc
people.known_for: Greenland Inuit omega-3 studies (1970s); 2010 study showing triglyceride-form fish oil bioavailability ~70% vs ethyl ester ~27%

molecules.name: Cholecalciferol (Vitamin D3)
molecules.label_th: วิตามินดี3 (โคเลแคลซิเฟอรอล)
molecules.role: Animal/UVB-derived form of vitamin D; converted to 25(OH)D in liver; ~87% more effective than D2 at raising serum 25(OH)D (Tripkovic 2012)

molecules.name: Ergocalciferol (Vitamin D2)
molecules.label_th: วิตามินดี2 (เออร์โกแคลซิเฟอรอล)
molecules.role: Plant/fungal form; prescription form in some markets; shorter half-life and weaker 25(OH)D elevation than D3

molecules.name: 25-Hydroxyvitamin D (calcidiol)
molecules.label_th: 25-ไฮดรอกซีวิตามินดี
molecules.role: Main circulating form; measured in blood to assess vitamin D status (Endocrine Society sufficient ≥30 ng/mL; IOM sufficient ≥20 ng/mL)

molecules.name: 1,25-Dihydroxyvitamin D (calcitriol)
molecules.label_th: 1,25-ไดไฮดรอกซีวิตามินดี (แคลซิไทรออล)
molecules.role: Active hormonal form; produced by kidney 1α-hydroxylase (CYP27B1); binds VDR; regulates >200 genes including calcium/phosphate homeostasis

molecules.name: CYP27B1 (1α-hydroxylase)
molecules.label_th: เอนไซม์ 1α-ไฮดรอกซิเลส
molecules.role: Converts 25(OH)D → 1,25(OH)2D in kidney; also expressed extra-renally (immune cells, skin) for paracrine vitamin D action

molecules.name: Menaquinone-7 (MK-7)
molecules.label_th: เมนาควิโนน-7 (MK-7)
molecules.role: Long-chain K2 (from natto, fermented foods); serum half-life ~72 h — activates Matrix Gla Protein (calcification inhibitor) and osteocalcin

molecules.name: Menaquinone-4 (MK-4)
molecules.label_th: เมนาควิโนน-4 (MK-4)
molecules.role: Short-chain K2 (from animal tissues, converted from K1 in tissues); serum half-life ~1-2 h — requires multi-dose/day for steady-state

molecules.name: Matrix Gla Protein (MGP)
molecules.label_th: Matrix Gla Protein
molecules.role: Vascular calcification inhibitor; requires K2-dependent γ-carboxylation to activate — the 'routing' mechanism keeping calcium out of arteries

molecules.name: Osteocalcin
molecules.label_th: ออสเทโอแคลซิน
molecules.role: Bone matrix protein; requires K2-dependent γ-carboxylation to bind calcium → deposit into bone

molecules.name: Magnesium bisglycinate
molecules.label_th: แมกนีเซียมไบกลัยซิเนต
molecules.role: Mg bound to 2 glycine molecules; high bioavailability, minimal laxative effect; glycine itself is calming (glycine receptor)

molecules.name: Magnesium oxide
molecules.label_th: แมกนีเซียมออกไซด์
molecules.role: High elemental Mg content but low absorption (~4% in Firoz & Graber 2001); cheap; useful mainly as osmotic laxative

molecules.name: Magnesium L-threonate
molecules.label_th: แมกนีเซียมทรีโอเนต
molecules.role: Developed at MIT (Liu 2010); claimed preferential CNS penetration; research mostly in rodents for cognition

molecules.name: Magnesium citrate
molecules.label_th: แมกนีเซียมซิเตรต
molecules.role: Mg bound to citric acid; bioavailability ~4x magnesium oxide (Walker 2003); commonly used laxative form

molecules.name: Zinc picolinate
molecules.label_th: ซิงค์พิโคลิเนต
molecules.role: Zn bound to picolinic acid; preferred absorption in some crossover studies (Barrie 1987) vs gluconate/citrate

molecules.name: Zinc gluconate
molecules.label_th: ซิงค์กลูโคเนต
molecules.role: Form in cold-lozenge trials (Prasad/Mossad); reasonably bioavailable; common OTC form

molecules.name: Zinc oxide
molecules.label_th: ซิงค์ออกไซด์
molecules.role: Cheapest form; poor solubility at neutral pH → low bioavailability; used in topical sunscreens primarily

molecules.name: Copper
molecules.label_th: ทองแดง (Cu)
molecules.role: Cofactor for ceruloplasmin, lysyl oxidase, SOD1; depleted by chronic high-dose zinc via metallothionein sequestration

molecules.name: Methylcobalamin
molecules.label_th: เมทิลโคบาลามิน
molecules.role: Active methyl-donor form; cofactor of methionine synthase (homocysteine → methionine); crosses CNS readily

molecules.name: Cyanocobalamin
molecules.label_th: ไซยาโนโคบาลามิน
molecules.role: Stable synthetic form used in cheap supplements/fortification; must lose CN group and be converted to MeCbl/AdoCbl to function

molecules.name: Adenosylcobalamin
molecules.label_th: อะดีโนซิลโคบาลามิน
molecules.role: Mitochondrial B12 form — cofactor of methylmalonyl-CoA mutase; deficiency elevates methylmalonic acid (MMA)

molecules.name: L-5-methyltetrahydrofolate (5-MTHF)
molecules.label_th: แอล-5-เมทิลเททราไฮโดรโฟเลต
molecules.role: Bioactive folate form; bypasses MTHFR C677T polymorphism; donates methyl group to B12 → methionine → SAMe

molecules.name: Methylmalonic acid (MMA)
molecules.label_th: กรดเมทิลมาโลนิก (MMA)
molecules.role: Elevated serum/urine MMA is a sensitive early marker of functional B12 deficiency (more specific than serum B12)

molecules.name: Homocysteine
molecules.label_th: โฮโมซิสเทอีน
molecules.role: Elevated when B12/folate/B6 insufficient — cardiovascular/cognitive risk marker; lowered by methyl-B12 + 5-MTHF

molecules.name: S-adenosylmethionine (SAMe)
molecules.label_th: S-adenosylmethionine
molecules.role: Product of B12/folate methylation cycle; methylates DNA, neurotransmitters, phospholipids

molecules.name: Eicosapentaenoic acid (EPA)
molecules.label_th: อีโคซาเพนตาอีโนอิก แอซิด (EPA)
molecules.role: Precursor of E-series resolvins, anti-inflammatory 3-series eicosanoids; cardiovascular focus

molecules.name: Docosahexaenoic acid (DHA)
molecules.label_th: โดโคซาเฮกซะอีโนอิก แอซิด (DHA)
molecules.role: Major structural fatty acid of brain gray matter, retinal photoreceptors; D-series resolvin precursor

molecules.name: Triglyceride (rTG/TG) fish oil
molecules.label_th: น้ำมันปลาแบบไตรกลีเซอไรด์
molecules.role: Omega-3 in natural TG backbone; ~70% bioavailability vs ~27% for ethyl ester (Dyerberg 2010)

molecules.name: Ethyl ester (EE) fish oil
molecules.label_th: น้ำมันปลาแบบเอทิลเอสเทอร์
molecules.role: Concentrated EE form from molecular distillation; cheaper but lower absorption without fatty meal

molecules.name: Ferrous bisglycinate
molecules.label_th: ไอรอนไบกลัยซิเนต (เฟอร์รัสไบกลัยซิเนต)
molecules.role: Fe bound to 2 glycines; higher bioavailability and fewer GI side effects than ferrous sulfate (Bovell-Benjamin 2000)

molecules.name: Selenomethionine
molecules.label_th: เซเลโนเมไทโอนิน
molecules.role: Food-form selenium (Brazil nuts, yeast); incorporated non-specifically into proteins — higher tissue retention vs sodium selenite

molecules.name: Se-methyl-L-selenocysteine (MSC)
molecules.label_th: เมทิลเซเลโนซิสเทอีน
molecules.role: Metabolized directly to active methylselenol without protein incorporation; studied in SELECT-era chemoprevention research

molecules.name: Liposomal vitamin C
molecules.label_th: วิตามินซีลิโพโซมอล
molecules.role: Encapsulated vitamin C claiming higher plasma AUC vs equal-dose oral (Davis 2016 — ~1.77× higher)

molecules.name: CYP3A4
molecules.label_th: CYP3A4 (เอนไซม์ตับ)
molecules.role: Metabolizes ~50% of drugs; induced by St. John's wort; inhibited by grapefruit → a major supplement-drug interaction axis

organizations.name: Institute of Medicine / National Academies (now NASEM)
อย. / Thai FDA (Food and Drug Administration, Ministry of Public Health)

case_studies.name: Holick 'Vitamin D Deficiency' NEJM 2007
case_studies.claim_to_fame: Landmark review estimating ~1 billion people worldwide have vitamin D deficiency or insufficiency; framed 25(OH)D <20 ng/mL as deficiency, 21-29 ng/mL as insufficiency
case_studies.source: Holick MF. Vitamin D Deficiency. NEJM 2007;357:266-281. PMID:17634462

case_studies.name: Zinc-induced copper deficiency anemia case reports
case_studies.claim_to_fame: Long-term zinc supplementation >50 mg/day (including denture-cream overuse) causes sideroblastic anemia and myeloneuropathy via copper depletion; documented in Fosmire 1990 review and multiple case reports
case_studies.source: Fosmire GJ. Am J Clin Nutr 1990;51(2):225-7; Willis et al. 2005; Hedera 2017 neuropathy reviews

case_studies.name: Tripkovic D3 vs D2 Meta-Analysis
case_studies.claim_to_fame: Meta-analysis of 7 RCTs showing cholecalciferol (D3) is significantly more effective than ergocalciferol (D2) at raising serum 25(OH)D — particularly with bolus dosing
case_studies.source: Tripkovic L et al. Am J Clin Nutr 2012;95(6):1357-64. PMID:22552031

case_studies.name: Dyerberg TG vs EE fish oil bioavailability
case_studies.claim_to_fame: Direct comparison in 72 subjects over 2 weeks — natural triglyceride-form omega-3 absorption ~70% vs ethyl ester ~27% (measured as incorporation into plasma lipids)
case_studies.source: Dyerberg J et al. Prostaglandins Leukot Essent Fatty Acids 2010;83(3):137-41. PMID:20638827

case_studies.name: Chailurkit Thai Vitamin D Survey
case_studies.claim_to_fame: National survey in sunshine-abundant Thailand found 45.2% of Thai adults had 25(OH)D <30 ng/mL and 5.7% had <20 ng/mL; urban women had highest deficiency — counter-intuitive given latitude
case_studies.source: Chailurkit LO, Aekplakorn W, Ongphiphadhanakul B. BMC Public Health 2011;11:853. PMC3239301

case_studies.name: Schurgers MK-7 vs MK-4 pharmacokinetics
case_studies.claim_to_fame: Head-to-head pharmacokinetics — MK-7 plasma half-life ~72 h (3 days) vs MK-4 ~1-2 h, enabling sustained γ-carboxylation of osteocalcin and MGP with once-daily dosing
case_studies.source: Schurgers LJ et al. Blood 2007;109(8):3279-83. PMID:17138823

case_studies.name: Firoz & Graber Magnesium Form Absorption
case_studies.claim_to_fame: Crossover study — magnesium oxide bioavailability only ~4% vs magnesium chloride/lactate/aspartate at 5-fold higher absorption; canonical reference for 'form matters' magnesium narrative
case_studies.source: Firoz M, Graber M. Magnes Res 2001;14(4):257-62. PMID:11794633
